It directly bears on the Narrative_ContentDerivedIdentificationGuaranteesCommit and Position_PipelineSlugGenerationOnMissingId, which concern how the pipeline derives identifiers from content when explicit IDs are omitted — the title's 'should not win' framing suggests this is a test case where the title must NOT be chosen as the slug. Actor_XenaExpertgh is included as the sole participant and voice across all expressions.
